Do violent video games lead to violence? While a growing body of research suggests such games can make
players more aggressive, I believe they do not directly cause real violence; rather, their influence depends on
the individual and the surrounding environment.
To begin with, exposure to violent scenes may indeed shape behavior. First, children who spend hours shooting
and fighting on screen can gradually treat aggression as normal, and some may copy what they see when they

proper parental supervision and healthy habits. Therefore, rather than simply blaming the games, parents and

Is technology making people lazy? My answer is a qualified yes: while technology itself is neutral, the way

To begin with, technology encourages mental laziness. When a search engine can answer any question in
seconds and a navigation app can guide every turn, few people bother to think, memorize or reason on their
